Private Function Keys(ByVal ws As Worksheet) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    For i = 1 To ws.Sort.SortFields.Count
        With ws.Sort.SortFields(i)
            s = s & ";" & .Key.Address(False, False) & ":" & .Priority & ":" & .Order
        End With
    Next
    Keys = ws.Sort.SortFields.Count & "=" & Mid(s, 2)
End Function

Private Function Grid(ByVal ws As Worksheet) As String
    Dim c As Range, s As String
    For Each c In ws.Range("A1:C5")
        s = s & "|" & c.Formula
    Next
    Grid = Mid(s, 2)
End Function

Private Function Walked(ByVal sf As Object) As String
    Dim f As Object, s As String
    For Each f In sf
        s = s & ";" & f.Key.Address(False, False)
    Next
    Walked = Mid(s, 2)
End Function

Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, sf As Object, f As Object
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    ws.Range("A1:C5").Value = Application.Transpose(Application.Transpose(Array(Array(2, "b", 9), Array(1, "a", 8), Array(2, "a", 7), Array(1, "b", 6), Array(3, "c", 5))))
    Set sf = ws.Sort.SortFields
    sf.Clear
    sf.Add ws.Range("A1:A5")
    sf.Add ws.Range("B1:B5")
    sf.Add ws.Range("C1:C5"), , xlDescending
    ws.Sort.SetRange ws.Range("A1:C5")
    ws.Sort.Header = xlNo
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        Tried = Keys(ws)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\plain.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 1
        sf(3).Priority = 1
        Tried = Keys(ws)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\first.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 2
        sf(1).Priority = 3
        Tried = Keys(ws)
    Case 3
        sf(2).Priority = 2
        Tried = Keys(ws)
    Case 4
        sf(1).Priority = 0
        Tried = Keys(ws)
    Case 5
        sf(1).Priority = 4
        Tried = Keys(ws)
    Case 6
        sf(1).Priority = 9
        Tried = Keys(ws)
    Case 7
        sf(1).Priority = -1
        Tried = Keys(ws)
    Case 8
        sf(3).Priority = 1
        ws.Sort.Apply
        Tried = Grid(ws)
    Case 9
        sf(2).Delete
        Tried = Keys(ws)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\deleted.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 10
        Set f = sf(2)
        f.Delete
        Tried = TypeName(f)
    Case 11
        Set f = sf(2)
        f.Delete
        Tried = f.Order
    Case 12
        Set f = sf(3)
        sf(1).Delete
        Tried = f.Priority & " " & f.Key.Address
    Case 13
        sf(1).Delete
        sf(1).Delete
        sf(1).Delete
        Tried = sf.Count
    Case 14
        sf(2).Delete
        ws.Sort.Apply
        Tried = Grid(ws)
    Case 15
        sf(1).ModifyKey ws.Range("C1:C5")
        Tried = Keys(ws)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\modified.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 16
        sf(1).ModifyKey ws.Range("E1")
        Tried = Keys(ws)
    Case 17
        sf(1).ModifyKey ws.Range("A1:B5")
        Tried = Keys(ws)
    Case 18
        sf(1).ModifyKey ws.Range("A1,C1")
        Tried = Keys(ws)
    Case 19
        sf(1).ModifyKey wb.Worksheets.Add.Range("A1:A5")
        Tried = sf(1).Key.Parent.Name
    Case 20
        sf(1).ModifyKey "A1"
        Tried = Keys(ws)
    Case 21
        sf.Clear
        sf.Add(ws.Range("A1:A5"), xlSortOnCellColor).SortOnValue.Color = vbRed
        sf(1).ModifyKey ws.Range("B1:B5")
        Tried = sf(1).SortOn & " " & sf(1).SortOnValue.Color & " " & sf(1).Order
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\colour.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 22
        sf.Clear
        sf.Add(ws.Range("A1:A5"), xlSortOnFontColor).SortOnValue.Color = vbRed
        sf(1).ModifyKey ws.Range("B1:B5")
        Tried = sf(1).SortOn & " " & sf(1).SortOnValue.Color
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\font.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 23
        sf.Clear
        sf.Add(ws.Range("A1:A5"), xlSortOnCellColor, xlDescending).SortOnValue.Color = vbRed
        sf(1).ModifyKey ws.Range("C1:C5")
        Tried = sf(1).SortOn & " " & sf(1).SortOnValue.Color & " " & sf(1).Order
    Case 24
        sf(2).CustomOrder = "c,b"
        sf(2).ModifyKey ws.Range("B1:B5")
        Tried = TypeName(sf(2).CustomOrder) & " [" & sf(2).CustomOrder & "]"
    Case 25
        sf(2).SubField = "Population"
        ws.Sort.Apply
        Tried = Grid(ws)
    Case 26
        Tried = TypeName(sf(1).CustomOrder) & " [" & sf(1).CustomOrder & "]"
    Case 27
        sf.Add ws.Range("A1:A5"), , , "x,y, z"
        Tried = TypeName(sf(4).CustomOrder) & " [" & sf(4).CustomOrder & "]"
    Case 28
        sf.Add ws.Range("A1:A5"), , , 1
        Tried = TypeName(sf(4).CustomOrder) & " [" & sf(4).CustomOrder & "]"
    Case 29
        sf.Add ws.Range("A1:A5"), , , ""
        Tried = TypeName(sf(4).CustomOrder) & " [" & sf(4).CustomOrder & "]"
    Case 30
        sf(2).CustomOrder = "c,b , a"
        Tried = TypeName(sf(2).CustomOrder) & " [" & sf(2).CustomOrder & "]"
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\custom.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 31
        sf(2).CustomOrder = "c,b,a"
        ws.Sort.Apply
        Tried = Grid(ws)
    Case 32
        sf(2).CustomOrder = 1
        Tried = TypeName(sf(2).CustomOrder) & " [" & sf(2).CustomOrder & "]"
    Case 33
        sf(2).CustomOrder = 1
        Tried = sf.Count
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\listed.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 34
        sf(2).CustomOrder = 0
        Tried = sf.Count
    Case 35
        sf(2).CustomOrder = "c,b"
        sf(2).CustomOrder = 0
        Tried = sf.Count
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\zero.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 36
        sf(2).CustomOrder = "c,b"
        sf(2).CustomOrder = 0
        Tried = TypeName(sf(2).CustomOrder) & " [" & sf(2).CustomOrder & "]"
    Case 37
        sf(2).CustomOrder = -1
        Tried = sf.Count
    Case 38
        sf(2).CustomOrder = "c,b"
        sf(2).CustomOrder = ""
        Tried = TypeName(sf(2).CustomOrder) & " [" & sf(2).CustomOrder & "]"
    Case 39
        sf(2).CustomOrder = 999
        Tried = TypeName(sf(2).CustomOrder) & " [" & sf(2).CustomOrder & "]"
    Case 40
        sf(2).CustomOrder = Array("c", "b")
        Tried = TypeName(sf(2).CustomOrder) & " [" & sf(2).CustomOrder & "]"
    Case 41
        Tried = TypeName(sf(1).SubField) & " [" & sf(1).SubField & "]"
    Case 42
        sf(1).SubField = "Population"
        Tried = TypeName(sf(1).SubField) & " [" & sf(1).SubField & "]"
    Case 43
        Tried = TypeName(sf(1).Parent) & " " & TypeName(sf.Parent) & " " & (sf.Parent Is ws.Sort) & " " & (sf(1).Parent Is sf)
    Case 44
        Tried = TypeName(sf(1).Application) & " " & TypeName(sf.Application) & " " & sf(1).Creator & " " & sf.Creator
    Case 45
        Tried = sf(2).Key.Address & " " & sf.Item(3).Order & " " & TypeName(sf(1))
    Case 46
        Tried = Walked(sf)
    Case 47
        Tried = sf(4).Order
    Case 48
        Tried = sf(0).Order
    Case 49
        Tried = sf("A1:A5").Order
    End Select
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim s As String, i As Long
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 49
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
